_doc: Box-score expected (deserved) score, VERSION 3/4: CFB = version 3 (the user's 'option 4', Nov 3 2026); NFL = version 4 (Nov 8 2026: v3 + a yards-per-play term, each play capped at 30 yds, all weights >= 0; CFB tested and not adopted): xPts = max(0, intercept + drives*b_drives + drives*avail/100*b_drivesXavail + drives*success/100*b_drivesXsuccess + drives*explosive/100*b_drivesXexpl + drives*yardsPerPlay(30-yd cap)/10*b_drivesXypp), rounded to 0.1. Success rate (EPA>0) is the core; explosive plays are rewarded via the explosive-rate term but every play's gain counts at most 'cap' (20) yards toward the available-yards share (mean over drives of min(capped yards / yards to goal, 1)), so a long TD is partly treated as variance. Turnovers: a drive that ends in a turnover counts exactly what it gained (like a punt) - never an extra penalty, never a bonus. Garbage time is faded out (NFL: win probability 90-98%; CFB: margin 43/37/27/22 by quarter +/-7) with small-sample blending ('shrink' = plays, drives). Inputs per box: xptsInputs {av, sr, ex} (sr/ex = box-score rates + garbage-time shift). Code: xpts_v3.py; NFL weights fitted on 2016-2025 (nfl_xpts_grid.py: forward prediction MAE 10.344 vs 10.458 for the previous formula), CFB on 2026. xWin = round(100/(1+exp(-winSlope*(xPts - opp xPts)))).
